caption: The drawing depicts a single, full-length dress with a fitted bodice and a wide, voluminous skirt. The dress features long, wide sleeves that open at the ends with visible white lace trim. The main fabric of the dress is patterned with vertical stripes composed of brown floral vine motifs alternating with clusters of pink flowers and green leaves on a pale cream background. The dress has a high, round neckline finished with a white lace collar. At the center front, there are decorative seam lines running from the collar to the waistband. The cuffs of the sleeves are also lined with white lace, and a small amount of bright pink fabric can be seen at the inner edge of the sleeves. The entire composition is centered on a plain, light background. No other objects or people are present in the drawing.
title: Dress
